SYMPTOM: Emotes (and any state-dependent logic) inside WS message handler never see updated React state — always sees initial value from when the effect ran
  CAUSE: useEffect with WS setup closes over initial state value; React state updates don't penetrate the closure
  FIX: Create a ref alongside the state:
    const approvalsRef = useRef(approvals)
    useEffect(() => { approvalsRef.current = approvals }, [approvals])
    // Inside WS handler, use approvalsRef.current instead of approvals
  PREVENT: Any time you read React state inside a WS handler, event listener, or long-lived callback — use a ref synced via useEffect
